name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre brings a wealth of experience to EKS JC, having spent over two decades in the marketing sector. His journey began in traditional advertising, but his passion for motorsport led him to seek opportunities within the racing world. He started small, volunteering at local rally events, eventually landing a marketing role with a regional racing team. 

Jean-Pierre's approach is data-driven and results-oriented. He believes in understanding the target audience intimately and crafting campaigns that resonate on a personal level. He's particularly adept at leveraging digital channels to reach new fans and drive engagement. His distinctive ability is to find creative, cost-effective solutions that deliver maximum impact, something that sets him apart in the competitive world of motorsport marketing.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Jean-Pierre is of average height with a slightly stocky build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook for jotting down marketing ideas.
Has a collection of vintage motorsport posters in his office.
Insists on having a specific type of Swiss chocolate readily available.
